decision: Extend all eight arms to 6000 episodes per training seed
reason: All 16 pilot replicas have validation median zero. Epsilon remains .223 (standard) or .122 (reduced-exploration), so lack of early success cannot distinguish an ineffective discretization from insufficient learning. No configuration is claimed effective yet.

All three have lower validation mean than the control on both training seeds, median zero, and negative paired bootstrap mean differences: alpha -0.27 (95% -0.44,-0.13), fine -0.285 (-0.46,-0.12), combined -0.31 (-0.53025,-0.12). Stop for sample-efficiency under this budget; no claim of universal ineffectiveness.

unchanged: All hyperparameters and rewards equal control
reason: Baseline almost never visits unknown states, yet fails at pipe fronts; original 49-pixel relative and 47-pixel horizontal bins alias critical approaches. Focused ranges allocate ~14-pixel relative distance resolution while reducing redundant absolute-height/velocity resolution. Nominal table size 221184 vs baseline 663552. Retains all five observations, no scripted actions.
budget_note: Stopping three arms at 6000 saves 24000 planned screening episodes; focused screening costs at most 20000. Total possible study episodes 260000 including two finalists.

decision: Continue focused to 10000 for equal-budget screening
reason: Focused representation achieves one median of 1 and uses ~3100 states vs ~5000 control at 6000. It is mixed across two seeds, so it is not claimed superior; an equal-budget check is justified by lower memory and comparable early performance.

decision: Advance two top robust validation configurations to 24000 episodes and a third training seed

reason: Current reward medians 54 vs 52 are practically close while validation P10 differs 3.0 vs 11.8. Do not let a marginal median difference outweigh lower-tail reliability. Rule is recorded before any locked-test access; family ranking unchanged.
